def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0]
    fives=[(i,j) for i,j,v in cells if v==5]
    def attached(p):
        i,j=p
        return any(0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w and grid[i+di][j+dj] not in (0,5)
                   for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0))
    src=[p for p in fives if attached(p)]
    src=src[0] if src else fives[0]
    dst=[p for p in fives if p!=src][0]
    di,dj=dst[0]-src[0], dst[1]-src[1]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    out[dst[0]][dst[1]]=0
    for i,j,v in cells:
        a,b=i+di,j+dj
        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and v!=5:
            out[a][b]=v
    return out
